messages:
eva: Quick sweep summary for embeddings + small-chat across L4 / T4 / A10G in us-west / eu-west / apac. TL;DR: A10G gives best small-chat latency (p50/p95), L4 gives best raw embedding throughput per GPU for long batches, T4 is the cheapest for bursty short-requests when using int8. Full notes below and a couple caveats.

bench-bot: Auto-report attached: https://dash.internal/redwood/bench/1719123456 :bar_chart:

bench-bot: CSV snippet:
```
region,gpu,workload,batch,quant,p50(ms),p95(ms),tokens/s,gpu_cost_per_hour
us-west,A10G,small-chat,1,fp16,18,64,240,6.5
us-west,L4,embed,64,int8,85,230,5500,5.2
us-west,T4,embed,8,int8,45,130,980,2.1
eu-west,A10G,small-chat,1,fp16,22,78,210,6.8
apac,L4,embed,64,int8,95,260,5100,5.6
apac,T4,small-chat,1,int8,28,92,175,2.4
```

eva: Notes:
- Kernel choices: A10G runs `fused_attn_v2` + fused_gelu, L4 benefited from `kv-cache-optimized` path and our experimental `qkv-merge` kernel in eu-west (reduced memory churn). T4 still used the generic cuda kernel but with aggressive small-batch packing.
- Quantization: int8 is stable for embeddings; int4 showed a small quality regression on small-chat (SAC metric down ~3% on our micro-eval set) — more on that below.
- Cost: normalized tokens/sec per $ shows L4 best for heavy embedding workloads, but when latency SLO matters for chat (p95 < 100ms) A10G is the only consistent option in us-west/eu-west. T4 is the best cost compromise for occasional chat spikes if you can accept p95 ~120ms.

noah: Can you paste the perf vs batch curves? curious about the knee for L4 embeddings (64->128).

eva: Pasted quick curves to the dashboard link. Short answer: L4 throughput keeps scaling to 128 for embeddings with diminishing returns after 96; memory pressure increases but still under threshold with our `kv-cache-optimized` kernel. T4 tops out around 48.

sasha: On int4 quality drop — did we run our regen tests + hallucination checks? Any examples?

eva: Ran eval set A (1k examples) + hallucination heuristic. int4 small-chat showed: answer length slightly shorter, 2.9% decrease in factuality score, and 1.6% increase in repetition. Sample: model omitted a numeric detail in a finance prompt. We suspect activation clipping from quant backend.

devin: For production, propose policy: embeddings use L4 pooled nodes with autoscale; small-chat default to A10G for p95-sensitive routes, fallback to T4 during capacity pressure. Also add an eval gate where int4 is allowed only for non-factual assistant prompts.

sasha: Sounds good. Also add a continuous synthetic probe to catch regressions early if we flip to int4.

eva: Agreed. Action items: 
- eva: push updated kernel flags to eu-west L4 test pool (enable qkv-merge) — ETA EOD.
- noah: add probe tests for int4 small-chat quality (10k daily micro-evals) — ETA tomorrow.
- devin: draft routing policy for chat vs embed (A10G/L4/T4) and capacity sizing notes for monthly reserved vs burst — ETA Thurs.

bench-bot: Note: A10G reserved sizing estimate for 99th percentile chat traffic (us-west): 12 GPUs for 10k rps sustained (p50 ~18ms), add 3 spare for burst SLA.

eva: Thanks, will iterate. tagging @devops for regional binpack sanity check. :thumbsup:
